item.title: Where the Money Goes in Prediction Markets
item.description:
72 million Kalshi trades, 8 charts, 5 minutes.

Las Vegas Strip slot machines return about 93¢ on the dollar; some Kalshi longshots have returned as little as 43¢. That comparison opens Jon Becker’s The Microstructure of Wealth Transfer in Prediction Markets, a study of 72.1 million trades covering $18.26 billion in volume, from June 2021 through November 2025 (Q4 2025 is partial). I wanted the short version: who puts money in, and who gets it back? Eight charts do most of the work.
